test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following describes the most appropriate meaning of ‘withdrawn’ according to the context?
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Lost in themselves'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the paragraph, it is stated, **"Some students are ‘withdrawn’, their social skills having been impacted by the long closure of schools"**
 
• Only the statement in option (4) draws parallelism with the excerpt from the paragraph.
 
• The statements in the other options are contextually incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is: *Lost in themselves*
